name: Vectipelta
isnote: Described as an ankylosaur from the Wessex Formation (Pond et al. 2023); relations inside Ankylosauria are not settled in the sources used.
sum: Vectipelta is an Early Cretaceous ankylosaur from the Wessex Formation of the Isle of Wight, England, known from a partial skeleton.
holotype: IWCMS 1996.153 and IWCMS 2021.75, with many vertebrae, girdle parts, limb elements and osteoderms — Wessex Formation, Chilton Chine, Isle of Wight.
biology: Armoured herbivore; no behavioural data in the sources used.
author: Pond et al. 2023
